description.en: A voluntary contributory pension scheme for eligible Indian citizens, especially people in the unorganised sector, administered through a bank or post-office savings account.

benefit_summary.en: After age 60, the subscriber receives the selected government-guaranteed minimum pension of Rs 1,000, Rs 2,000, Rs 3,000, Rs 4,000, or Rs 5,000 per month. Contribution depends on entry age and selected pension; spouse and nominee benefits apply under scheme rules.

eligibility_summary.en: An Indian citizen aged 18 through 40 with a savings bank or post-office savings account may join. A person who is or has been an income-tax payer as of application cannot open a new APY account under the current rule.

prompt.en: What is your age in completed years?
Do you have a bank or post-office savings account?
Are you, or have you been, an income-tax payer as of this application?

description.en: The applicant is at least 18 years old.
The applicant is no more than 40 years old at entry.
The applicant is an Indian citizen.
The applicant has a bank or post-office savings account.
The applicant is or has been an income-tax payer as of application.

name.en: Completed APY registration form or eAPY application
Bank or post-office savings account details
Identity and KYC details requested by the account provider

instruction.en: Use eAPY or approach the bank branch or post office where the savings account is held.
Choose the pension amount and review the age-based contribution before enrolling.
Maintain the account balance required for scheduled contributions and keep spouse and nominee details current.

citation.publisher: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
